post.title: Why dealers ask your monthly payment: the $2,790 math
post.ig:
This lower car payment costs $2,790 more.

Hypothetical $35,000 at 7% APR: $693.04 a month over 60 months vs $528.24 over 84. Interest: $6,583 vs $9,372.
A $1,500 add-on over 84 months adds just $22.64 a month; the FTC calls hiding add-ons in a payment 'payment packing.'
Edmunds: loans of 84+ months hit a record 25.5% of new-car financing in Q3 2026, up from 21.8% in Q3 2025.

Sources: Edmunds (Q3 2026); FTC; CFPB Regulation Z.
